mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.receipt_no, r.purchase_order_id, r.purchase_order_no_snapshot AS purchase_order_no, r.supplier_id, r.supplier_name_snapshot AS supplier_name, r.warehouse_id, r.warehouse_name_snapshot AS warehouse_name, r.status, r.receipt_mode, r.putaway_status, r.putaway_at, r.putaway_by, r.received_at, r.confirmed_at, r.operator, r.remark, r.version, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM purchase_receipt r WHERE r.deleted = FALSE AND r.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM purchase_receipt WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM purchase_receipt WHERE deleted = FALSE AND purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} ORDER BY id ASC
